dedupe_keys.name: estpos national gnss reference station network of estonia

description: ESTPOS is the national GNSS satellite data centre of Estonia, run by the Land and Spatial Development Board. Its network of 40 GNSS reference stations covers the country evenly and is used to monitor the components of the Estonian geodetic reference system, above all coordinates and ground movements, and to provide real-time positioning with 2 to 5 cm accuracy. Observation data for the last 90 days is available through the ESTPOS user portal, where users can also run GNSS computations and coordinate transformations, and older data is archived by the board and supplied to users on request. The stations belong to the European Plate Observing System (EPOS) network, some are in the EUREF Permanent Network, and their data is used by Nordic Geodetic Commission and EUREF working groups; the centre was rebuilt in 2024 and 2025 with European Union NextGenerationEU funding. The page links a user guide dated 24 September 2026 and station plots. Access is through the user portal; the cost and licence terms were not stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in Estonian, and only 90 days of data are online. Coverage is Estonia. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, ground movement monitoring and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are the WALCORS network of Wallonia and the Netherlands GNSS reference data.
